title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 48
description: Ten questions on Genesis 48: Jacob adopts and blesses Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh.

questions.text: Whom did Joseph take with him when he heard that his father was sick?
questions.explanation: When Joseph was told his father was sick, he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

answers.text: His brother Benjamin and his servants
His two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim
His wife Asenath and her father

questions.text: Where did Jacob say God Almighty had appeared to him?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me."

answers.text: At Luz in the land of Canaan

questions.text: Jacob said Ephraim and Manasseh would be his, even as which two of his sons?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine."

questions.text: Where did Jacob say he had buried Rachel?
questions.explanation: Jacob said he buried Rachel on the way to Ephrath, also called Bethlehem.

answers.text: At the city gate of Luz

questions.explanation: The eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn't see well.

answers.text: His eyes were dim for age
He was in a dark tent

questions.text: What did Israel say God had let him see besides Joseph's face?
questions.explanation: Israel said, "I didn't think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also."

questions.text: On whose head did Israel lay his right hand?
questions.explanation: Israel laid his right hand on Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh's head.

questions.text: What did Joseph try to do when he saw where his father's right hand was?
questions.explanation: It displeased Joseph, and he held up his father's hand to move it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

questions.text: What did Israel say about the younger brother?
questions.explanation: Israel said, "His younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations."

answers.text: He would be greater than his older brother
He would serve his older brother
He would return to the land of Canaan alone
He would die young and have no offspring

questions.text: Out of whose hand did Israel say he took the portion he gave Joseph?
questions.explanation: Israel gave Joseph one portion above his brothers, "which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow."
